subject: DISPLAY statement
notes: CLOSED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB258 golden round) - both halves this row held open are landed or licensed, and both are now witnessed. || FORMAT 1 (device), re-derived element for element against 14.9.11.2's printed format and CobolParserCore.g4#displayStatement as it stands today: the operand brace repeats with '...' (the grammar's operand loop), UPON is optional, WITH is an OPTIONAL word before NO ADVANCING (it is not underlined - 5.2.3), END-DISPLAY is optional, and identifier-1 admits a function-identifier per 8.4.4.1. conformance:cases/14.9.11-DISPLAY/l1_display_format1_elements pins every one of those in four derived lines - A=0042|abc (one statement, a mixed identifier/literal operand LIST, 14.9.11.4 GR1's 'in the order listed'), S=[ ] (GR3 - a figurative constant contributes ONE occurrence, not the width of a neighbour), F=ABC (the function-identifier operand) and N1N2! (NO ADVANCING written with WITH and without it). conformance:cases/14.9.11-DISPLAY/l1_display_standard_device pins the UPON element and discriminates SYSERR from the standard display device. || THE END-DISPLAY EDITION ASYMMETRY IS FIXED (kb/Work PB134). The terminator used to be accepted at --std 85 with no gate at all while its END-ACCEPT twin had one - one of two twin terminators gated, which was the defect whatever edition number the derivation assigned. constructs.json now carries the ACTIVE row end-display-2002 with diagnosticCode COBOL0816 and the version matrix runs it at all four editions (conformance-test:VersionMatrixTests.Construct_MatchesEditionExpectation). MEASURED here: DISPLAY WS-X END-DISPLAY draws COBOL0816 'the END-DISPLAY scope terminator requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)' at 85 and compiles clean at 2002, 2014 and 2023. || FORMAT 2 (screen) IS DECLINED, NOT MISSING, AND THE DECLINE IS LOUD. Annex A.4.2 (ACCEPT and DISPLAY screen handling) is recorded 'Not claimed' in docs/CONFORMANCE.md, and Annex A.4.1 admits an optional element's syntax 'only when support for that language element is claimed by the implementor' - so screen-name-1, the AT LINE/COLUMN phrase and the [NOT] ON EXCEPTION pair are refused BY NAME with COBOL1707 through ScreenFacility (kb/Work PB260). The grammar's screenTail arm and its {!screenPositionAhead()}? guard exist precisely so DISPLAY SG COLUMN 5 is DIAGNOSED rather than silently binding as a three-operand device DISPLAY, which is what it used to do. Witnesses: conformance:wiseowl/cases/14.9.11-DISPLAY/a42-display-screen-minimal and conformance:wiseowl/cases/14.9.11-DISPLAY/a42-display-screen-positioned. That half of the format is therefore UNREACHABLE rather than unverified - the same disposition GR-8.8.1.2-6 already carries for the declined standard-binary arithmetic mode. The repaired Figure notes' choice-indicator claims (the AT phrase's braces, the exception pair's brackets) are content OF that declined format and are recorded as A.4.2 posture, not as debt on this row. || Editions: batch default; Annex E carries no DISPLAY item.
